lines.speaker: Brom
lines.text: Word travels in Elarion. What do you need, defender?

lines.speaker: Brom
lines.text: The light fails at the realm's edge. Few return who chase it.

lines.speaker: Brom
lines.text: If you mean to, the board has the threads. Mind the dark.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: Welcome to the Echo Hollow. The echoes here seek a bond. Choose one and it will fight at your side, guard Elarion, and return to you always.

options.text: A frost-warden - the Ice Wolf. Steady and tough.
The Ice Wolf already walks with you.
A hearth-hound - the Flame Pup. Fierce and fast.
The Flame Pup already walks with you.
A heart-ward - the Aether Sprite. Quick and arcane.
The Aether Sprite already walks with you.
I'll return when I can take another.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Ice Wolf is attuned to you. It will chill any foe that nears the Heart.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Ice Wolf is already bonded to you - it answers your call when you need it.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Flame Pup answers your call. Its embers will scorch the enemy.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Flame Pup is already bonded to you - its embers are yours to command.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Aether Sprite flits to your side. It will ward the Heart with arcane light.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The Aether Sprite is already bonded to you - its arcane light is ever at your side.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: Welcome back. Your echo already walks with you - the bond is whole. When your bond can hold another, the echoes will be waiting.

lines.speaker: Echo Warden
lines.text: The hollow is always open when you are ready.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Hold - easy. Keep your hand off that hilt; if I wanted you down you'd not have heard me at all.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I've had eyes on you since the treeline. You're the new Keeper. The Heart's been louder since you came - even out here I felt it stir.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Sylas. Scout of the Reach. I've read these woods longer than the Hollow Ones have walked them.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I knew the people who gave themselves to that tree. Some of those Echoes were friends. So I keep the wild off the wall, and I don't ask for thanks.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Watching. There's a difference, and you'll learn it. A scout who follows gets seen. A scout who watches keeps you alive.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I'm Sylas - Scout of the Reach. And I don't trail just anyone through these trees.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: The wild's been restless. Something past the dark side of this land is pushing them toward Elarion - the Hollow Ones first, and worse behind them.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: I can read a trail three days cold. You can hold a wall. Apart, we each lose slow. Together, maybe we don't.

options.text: Why should I trust a stranger in the woods?

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: You shouldn't. Not on my word. So trust the arrow - I'll put one in whatever finds us first, and you can decide what I'm worth after.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: He lowers the bow, and something in his shoulders eases. Then it's settled. I walk where you walk, Keeper - and I put an arrow in whatever finds us first.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Stay near the wall when the horns sound. Out here, I'll go first - I always have.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Lead on. Let's see what the dark side of this land is hiding.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Suit yourself. Proud gets you killed out here, but it's your wall to bleed for.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: He fades back toward the trees. I'll be in the treeline when you change your mind, Keeper. You will.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: You made it to the wall. Good. I'm Sylas - Scout of the Reach. I've kept the wild off these stones since long before you came.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: The Heart's been louder since you arrived, Keeper. That's not nothing - it means the light still answers someone.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Here is the shape of it: drive the dark back from the Heart and the tree grows. A brighter Heart is a stronger Heart - and the echoes gather more for you while you fight.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: When the horns sound, hold the line. I'll take the treeline. Let's see what the dark side of this land is hiding.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: The grain comes slow in the Dimming, Keeper - but it comes. Drive the dark back and the fields will answer.

lines.speaker: Miller
lines.text: Stop by the build menu when you've crystal to spare and we'll raise what this mill can yield.

lines.speaker: Woodcutter
lines.text: Timber for the walls, timber for the fires. The forest gives what the Heart can spare, and no more.

lines.speaker: Woodcutter
lines.text: Care to grow the cut? The upgrade's yours to call when the coin's in hand.

lines.speaker: Arcanist
lines.text: The runes hum louder since you came, Keeper. The Heart's light feeds them, and through them the towers see far.

lines.speaker: Arcanist
lines.text: When you would deepen the weave, the tower stands ready to learn.

lines.speaker: Drillmaster
lines.text: Recruits sharpen by the hour, Keeper. Give the word and they'll march - Elarion's walls won't hold themselves.

lines.speaker: Drillmaster
lines.text: Strengthen the barracks and I'll turn out steadier blades for the line.

lines.speaker: Coppin
lines.text: Fresh stock off the morning carts, Keeper - tools, trinkets, and whatever the caravans dared to carry through the Dimming.

lines.speaker: Coppin
lines.text: Come, have a look before the good pieces go.

lines.speaker: Blacksmith
lines.text: The steel sings today, Keeper. Blades honed, hafts trued - a forge only rests when the walls do.

lines.speaker: Blacksmith
lines.text: Take up what the line needs.

lines.speaker: Armorer
lines.text: Plate, mail, and good boiled leather, Keeper - armor that holds when the wall does not.

lines.speaker: Armorer
lines.text: Step in and let's fit you proper.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Careful hands, Keeper - everything on this bench remembers a purpose. Rings, amulets, stones that still hold a little light.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Come, look closer.

lines.speaker: Herbalist
lines.text: Mind the fumes, Keeper - every tincture on this bench is a small argument with the Dimming.

lines.speaker: Herbalist
lines.text: Bring me herbs and I'll bring you back from anything. Step up to the bench.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Careful hands, Keeper - everything on this bench remembers a purpose. Rings, amulets, stones that still hold a little light.

lines.speaker: Sable
lines.text: Step up to the bench and we'll set a stone together.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Ho, Keeper! Over here - by the gate. Quickly now, before the light thins.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Sylas, Scout of the Reach. I know your name, Keeper - the whole town does.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Hear me: when the horns sound, they come for the gates. And they WILL sound.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: So we make ready first. Walk with me.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Before the horns sound, we build. See that gate? The last attack came through there.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Tap BUILD and raise a watchtower - this first one is on me.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Look at it stand! That's YOURS, Keeper - and it holds this gate with you.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: In town they come in WAVES, at the gates. Your towers hold the line - and you fight beside them.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Horns! Here they come - to the gate, Keeper!

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: The line held - you and that tower of yours, together. That is how home is kept.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Take your due - a defender earns their keep.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Out there is DIFFERENT. No walls. No towers.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: When something finds you in the open, it's you alone in the fight - start to finish. Go and learn it.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Alone - and enough. Remember the feel of that, Keeper.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Up, Keeper! The field forgives nothing - but it teaches fast. Again.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Home now. In town: waves at the gates, your towers beside you. Out there: just you.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Two fights, Keeper. Always know which one you're in.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: And look - the Tree stirs. You drove the dark back, and Elarion ANSWERED.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: When the horn calls DEFEND, fortify every gate. Venture out. Grow stronger. Defend better.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: It's all yours now, Keeper. I'll be by the gate.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: A new Echo has answered! Set it to a harvest - wood, iron or grain - and it will tend the work on its own.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: Coin enough to build, Keeper. Walls don't raise themselves - put it to work.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: New steel in your pack? Iron serves no one in a chest - equip it.

lines.speaker: Sylas
lines.text: A talent earned! Open your talents and shape how you fight, Keeper.
